err_already_laundered: The driver already took care of your cash this run.
err_no_launder: The driver is not interested in your cash.
notify_no_dirty: You have no marked bills on you.
err_not_allowed: You are not allowed to do that.
err_computer_busy: Someone else is using this computer.
err_offer_gone: This offer is no longer available.
err_has_active: You already have an active order. Finish or cancel it first.
err_fee: You cannot afford the accept fee (%s).
err_wrong_state: That cannot be done in the current state.
err_stash_remove: Items could not be taken from the storage.
err_stash_open: The storage could not be opened. Check the server console.
err_box_add: The box could not be added to the storage.
err_no_box: You are not carrying this order's box.
err_too_far: You are not close enough to the truck.
err_wrong_vehicle: This is not your delivery truck.
err_no_spot: No delivery spot available. Tell an admin.
notify_ready: Your order is ready. Start the shipment from the computer.
notify_shipped: Your box is ready at the pickup point (marked on the map). Take it to the delivery truck.
notify_placed: Box placed in the cargo. Close the rear door and the truck leaves.
notify_laundered: %s of your dirty money was cleaned. The driver kept his cut: %s
notify_expired: Your order timed out and was cancelled.
notify_truck_arrived: GPS set. Pick up the box, then bring it to the delivery truck.
notify_box_taken: You are carrying the box. No running, jumping or vehicles.
dev_spot_laser_desc: The truck faces the direction you are looking
dev_laser_hint: ENTER / left click: place   ·   BACKSPACE / ESC: cancel
dev_add_existing: Pick the object I am looking at
dev_editor_hint: TAB target · M mode · Arrows/PgUp/PgDn · [ ] size · SHIFT fast · CTRL slow · ENTER save · BACKSPACE quit
dev_need_vehicle: You must be in a vehicle.
dev_no_object: No object where you are looking.
task_take: Take the shipment box from the stash
task_truck: Carry it to the delivery truck
task_place: Put the box in the cargo
err_no_pickup: No box pickup point is set up. Tell an admin.
err_cant_carry: You cannot carry the box right now.
dev_pickup_add_desc: Spawns the box in front of you with a ghost player. TAB switches between the box and where the player stands, arrows / PgUp / PgDn move, M rotates, WASD walks. ENTER saves.
